crossRefs.note: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai…
Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying…
Joshua sent them out; and they went to set up the ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai; but…
There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.
The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.

parallels.note: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.
